context: 本案例完全合成，僅用於表格結構與填值測試，無法律效力，不可提交。所有人物、地址、電話、證號、案件編號及受理單位均為虛構；電話不可作實際聯絡，證號不是有效國民身分證號，所有簽名、印記與單位戳章均為合成文字占位，並非真實簽署或蓋印。表頭編號為SYNTHETIC-HPB-001。合成事故發生於民國115年8月10日14時25分，地點為虛構國道測試段零公里處。申請人是虛構代理人乙，出生日期為民國80年3月12日，國民身分證統一編號填SYNTHETIC-APPLICANT-001，聯絡電話填000-000-0101，地址填虛構市代理路零號。與當事人關係只選受當事人，不選本人，也不選當事人之利害關係人；本案為當事人委託其姊姊代辦。因此受當事人後的(關係)填姊姊。未選取的當事人之利害關係人分支仍保留其(關係)欄，該欄使用合成標記不適用（本案為受託代辦），不表示另有利害關係申請。申請事項依(擇一勾選)只選現場照片乙份 張。(事故發生7日後可申請)，不選現場圖乙份。(事故發生7日後可申請)，也不選交通事故初步分析研判表乙份。(事故發生30日後可申請)。現場照片乙份的張數填3。申請日期為民國115年9月18日，距事故已逾7日，符合原表印製的照片申請等待期；本情境不主張現行辦理規則。受理單位在臨櫃申請取件區填預定取件日期民國115年9月22日，案件編號SYNTHETIC-CASE-001，服務電話000-000-0100。本合成情境含預定日期當日完成取件的後續狀態，取件簽名填虛構代理人乙之合成取件簽名。此致機關在國道公路警察局第後填零，公路警察大隊後、分(小)隊前填示例；合稱國道公路警察局第零公路警察大隊示例分(小)隊，此單位不是真實機關。申請人簽章填虛構代理人乙之合成簽名，其（印）填虛構代理人乙之合成印記。受託分支須保留當事人區：當事人為虛構當事人甲，當事人簽章填虛構當事人甲之合成簽名，其（印）填虛構當事人甲之合成印記，身分證統一編號填SYNTHETIC-PARTY-001，地 址填虛構市當事路零號，電 話填000-000-0102。申請日期三格依序填115、9、18。承辦人填虛構承辦員丙，主管填虛構主管丁，(單位戳章)填虛構受理單位之合成戳章。原表備註及兩項附註均為固定文字，不作填值目標。
normalization_notes: Complete native one-page 1040721版 form, not a translated form or split excerpt. Preserve the header number, accident five-part date/time, location, applicant/birth/ID/contact block, relationship alternatives and both relationship blanks, requested record and photo quantity, receipt-office block, two receiving-agency blanks, two signature areas and their separate printed seal positions, party contact block, application date, handling officer, supervisor, office stamp, reminder, both notes and version marker.

The source's relationship and requested-record labels visually span several lines in shared cells; the pickup label visibly spans its date and service-phone rows. Normalize to 24-column rows with the original left-label/right-content grouping, keep the label in the first row and blank continuation cells beneath it. Birth information remains beside the applicant name; receipt date/case number remain paired above service phone/receipt signature. The shared renderer does not support rowspans, so this is a declared normalized layout, not pixel-identical reconstruction.

The source's relationship alternatives have circular markers. Represent them with the existing single-choice checkbox group without changing their order or meaning: 本人, 受當事人, 當事人之利害關係人. The source explicitly requires one requested-record option; retain its three square-box alternatives as another single-choice group.

The two conditional relationship blanks are embedded in choice text in the PDF. Keep both as separate targets on continuation rows beneath the group and use the contiguous original option-plus-(關係) phrase as each label: 受當事人 (關係) and 當事人之利害關係人 (關係). Repeat their source option text to make association unambiguous; retain 委託(請當事人於下欄親自簽章) and (請出示證明文件). No extra question or choice is invented.

The photo quantity is a distinct blank embedded in the second record option. The option preserves all literal text with PDF whitespace normalized to a single space; the 張。 target follows directly beneath the group with repeated source option context and its printed 7-day condition. The 30-day condition for the third option is also retained.

Individually fillable year/month/day/hour/minute blanks are independent targets with source-parent paths; they are not collapsed into a date/time string. Separate applicant and principal signature spaces from the visibly designated （印） seal spaces; each seal is a typed synthetic marker, not a generated signature image.

The large unruled lower source cell is normalized into consecutive 此致, agency-blank, applicant-signature/seal, party-signature/seal/contact and application-date rows in original reading order. Signature and agency grouping is preserved; no nested table or custom renderer is introduced. The two inline agency blanks use the literal preceding source labels 國道公路警察局第 and 公路警察大隊, with 分(小)隊 retained as fixed suffix.

Normalize extracted PDF whitespace/newlines to spaces in all placeholder labels/options to avoid the original Stage 6 non-DOTALL placeholder regex losing multiline labels. Exact source_anchor values preserve original PDF content-stream whitespace and line breaks. No Chinese wording, punctuation, waiting period, conditional instruction or footnote is translated or intentionally omitted.

The inactive interested-party relationship target uses a context-grounded synthetic N/A marker because the annotation contract requires nonblank text gold. Applicant, principal, receiving-office and later pickup values are all explicitly contextualized; filling administrative targets models a completed fictional workflow, not applicant authority to fill office-only fields.
Fonts, border thickness, line leaders and circular-vs-square control artwork are normalized using the shared renderer. The source has no logo or photograph requiring exclusion.

compatibility_issues.details: Shared renderer cannot represent rowspans. Original grouped labels and horizontal pairing are retained with colspans and blank continuation cells; exact visual rowspans are not claimed.

Two conditional relationship blanks and photo quantity are separately targeted after the associated choice group. Source text is repeated for association rather than silently dropping or merging controls.
